create_CarlaEnv: create a CarlaEnv instance to set up a CARLA driving simulation environment with configurable cameras and weather
run_CarlaEnv_step: run a single simulation step in CarlaEnv by applying a steer and throttle brake action
create_CarlaSyncMode: create a CarlaSyncMode context manager to synchronize sensor data from multiple CARLA cameras
run_RoamingAgentModified: run a RoamingAgentModified agent step to compute vehicle control with hazard detection and traffic light awareness
create_Weather: create a Weather object to dynamically change sun position and storm conditions in the CARLA world
